primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.2 Atmospheric Cloud Coverage, printed p.18 / PDF p.33
primary_records.original_meaning: Current cloud coverage represented as a list of Cloud Layer descriptions. A layer requires a category String; optional coverage describes cloud cover, base is altitude above sea level, height is measured from the layer base, and width is angular.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not a cloud-cover percentage, total sky fraction, ground-level visibility or a single mandatory layer. Suggested category/coverage Strings are examples, not a sealed enumeration. Cloud Layer is an Accepted CBRN extension implemented using Custom Types; base and height have different references.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.2 Atmospheric Dew Point, printed p.18 / PDF p.33
primary_records.original_meaning: Atmospheric temperature below which water droplets begin to condense and dew can form, represented by Measured Celsius: required value and optional error.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not the current air temperature, device-internal temperature or a freezing threshold. Preserve Celsius and the declared optional measurement error; no site, time, algorithm or manufacturer value is invented. The location fallback stated for the core atmospheric entries is not automatically extended to this entry.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.2 Atmospheric Humidity, printed p.18 / PDF p.33
primary_records.original_meaning: Measured humidity at the observation position. The Humidity composite expresses water relative to saturation at a given temperature and pressure with a required Percent value and optional Percent error. If the Position observable is absent, the observable definition uses the observing component position.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not absolute humidity, stored-energy percent or device-internal moisture. The Humidity error field has no one-standard-deviation rule in its own definition; do not silently borrow that rule from Measured Percent. A source fallback is not an authenticated surveyed probe point.

primary_records.original_meaning: Current precipitation represented by the Accepted Precipitation composite: a required category String and an optional rate of type Measured Mpsec.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not accumulated rainfall depth, event duration or an inferred interval total. Retain the source rate type in metres per second without inventing a measurement method, accumulation window or drop-fall interpretation. Category suggestions are not a sealed code list; the composite requires Custom Types.

primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not a pressure rating or automatically a sea-level-corrected barometric pressure. Preserve pascals and optional error; source units note 100 Pa = 1 hPa = 1 millibar, but no case-specific numerical conversion or source precision is fabricated.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.2 Atmospheric Wind, printed p.19 / PDF p.34
primary_records.proposed_label: Observed atmospheric wind category, speed and direction
primary_records.original_meaning: Measured atmospheric wind at the observation position, defaulting that position to the observing component when the Position observable is absent. primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not device Velocity or a mandatory speed/direction pair. An omitted speed with a schema default is not evidence that calm wind was actually measured. Preserve NOLL without inventing a from-versus-toward convention, numerical transformation or a measured direction for None. Wind categories and defaults remain separate.
